_what: Stage 00b intake gate. Filled BEFORE any digitiser was written (PIPELINE_V2 Sec 3). Every value this curation touches is named here with the tier it came from and, for anything at tier 5, why tiers 1-4 failed.

paper.title: Optimization of Lipid Nanoparticles for Gene Editing of the Liver via Intraduodenal Delivery
paper.identity_resolved_from: Europe PMC REST core record, one call, 2026-11-10
paper.original_data_discriminator: abstractText length 1473 (not 0) and the JATS carries 2. Materials and Methods and 3. Results and Discussion with named subsections. pubType was NOT used.

licence.article: NIH AUTHOR MANUSCRIPT. The JATS permissions block reads verbatim: 'This file is available for text mining. It may also be used consistent with the principles of fair use under the copyright law.' Europe PMC core record: isOpenAccess = N, license = null.
licence.verdict: NOT CC0/CC-BY. FAILS CLAUDE.md Sec 8. Same posture as the three other NIH author manuscripts measured in this run.

mmc2..mmc4.route: same CDN pattern, probed by me in .docx/.pdf/.xlsx/.zip
mmc2..mmc4.result: ALL 12 probes HTTP 404 returning a 189-byte XML error body (magic 3c3f786d). Only mmc1 exists. Confirms the orchestrator's finding independently.

figures.result: gr1..gr6 HTTP 200, magic ffd8ffe0, 3059x3180 to 3591x3475 px. gr7 404. These are the published figures at full publisher resolution; the PMC author-manuscript figure supplied to me (nihms-1986895-f0001.jpg) was not used for any value.

article_pdf.result: HTTP 403, 5522-byte HTML error page (magic 3c21444f43 = '<!DOC'). REJECTED BY MAGIC BYTES, not by a size floor. No article PDF was obtained, so there is NO page rect and therefore NO derivable native dpi for any figure (see tier_5 note).

pmc_bin_route.result: orchestrator: refused the SI as an HTML error page

europepmc_supplementaryFiles.result: orchestrator: 297-byte XML stub. Recorded in BROWSER_ACQUISITION.md.

acquisition.untrusted_data_posture: Every download went to a uniquely named, VERIFIED-EMPTY directory in the session scratchpad (asserted 0 entries before writing) and the docx was unzipped into a second such directory. No glob copy was used anywhere (F-065). Every parser lives in a different directory from the extracted archive and takes its input path as an argument; all runs are python3 -I.

accession_sweep.result: EXPLICIT NULL: 0 hits for every pattern. The paper has no data-availability statement, no deposit and no repository of its own.
accession_sweep.find_repo: provenance/tools/find_repo.py run TWICE, --author Zhu (first author) and --author Mao (PI). Neither returned a repository for this PMID; the only lipid-related hits are unrelated third-party projects, all correctly reported as non-matches.

value_sources.quantity: 'RLU in HepG2' per LNP, plus 5 printed weight percentages, Z-average and PDI
value_sources.how: Parsed from word/document.xml of mmc1.docx as a real table (w:tbl -> w:tr -> w:tc), not by counting tags and not from a text heuristic. Header asserted cell-by-cell before any row was read.
value_sources.corpus_admissible: NO -- ALREADY MERGED. Every one of the 192 values is the same number already in data_vitro.csv as YZ_2022 (PMID 35879315). See 02_corpus_overlap.json.
value_sources.note: The column header says 'measured in RLU' and the values run 1.705-9.233. They are NOT RLU; they are ln(RLU). A column header is a claim, not a measurement.

value_sources.quantity: Total bioluminescence flux from liver, photons/s, per INDIVIDUAL formulation, intraduodenal, 100 ug pDNA
value_sources.why_tiers_1_4_failed: Tier 1: no publisher Source Data file exists -- mmc2/mmc3/mmc4 were probed on the Elsevier CDN in four extensions each and all twelve returned HTTP 404. Tier 2: mmc1.docx contains six value tables and they are the in-vitro HepG2 tables only; no in-vivo flux appears in any table or in the SI text. Tier 3: no repository exists (see accession_sweep, explicit null over 78,475 chars plus two find_repo runs). Tier 4: no article PDF could be obtained (Europe PMC 403), and the figure is a publisher JPEG with no text layer and no vector layer, so there is nothing to read with pdfplumber and page.get_drawings() cannot be consulted at all.
value_sources.corpus_admissible: luminescence from a translated reporter -- admissible in KIND. See DECISIONS D-1/D-2 for why it is still not emitted.

value_sources.quantity: Total bioluminescence flux per organ (heart/liver/spleen/lung/kidney) for 6 formulations, plus 6 printed liver-share percentages
value_sources.corpus_admissible: admissible in kind; used here as a CHECK (the printed liver share is a quantity the authors drew but never computed from the bars).

value_sources.quantity: Liver flux for POOLED clusters of 8 LNPs (3A, 24 clusters; 3B, 9 clusters) and sub-clusters of 4 (3C, 10; 3D, 5 x 5 organs)
value_sources.corpus_admissible: NO -- not attributable. The injected dose is a physical mixture of 8 (or 4) different formulations and there is no barcode, so the flux is a sum over the pool and belongs to no single LNP. This is NOT the LR_2023 barcoded precedent, which resolves individual members.

value_sources.quantity: liver flux vs dose (100/500/1000 ug) for 4 formulations
value_sources.corpus_admissible: admissible in kind; a dose series of formulations already covered by Fig 4B.

value_sources.quantity: organ distribution of flux (4G) and of Cy5-pDNA (S3)
value_sources.corpus_admissible: 4G yes in kind; Fig S3 NO -- Cy5-labelled pDNA is particle/cargo biodistribution, not delivery.

value_sources.quantity: tdTomato+ cells per unit area; % tdTomato+ by FACS; TIDE indel %
value_sources.corpus_admissible: YES in kind -- Cas9 excision -> tdTomato is downstream of translation, and TIDE indel % is editing efficiency. All are for the SINGLE formulation CII-b3.
NO -- a downstream pharmacodynamic endpoint, not a delivery measurement.

value_sources.panel: Fig S1, S2, S4, S5, S6, S8
value_sources.quantity: size/PDI, survival, body weight, cytokine panel, confocal images
value_sources.corpus_admissible: NO -- none is a delivery measurement.

tier_5_resolution_note: Every figure here is a standalone publisher JPEG. There is no PDF page rect, so native dpi is NOT derivable and axis.native_tol() would have to be fed a guess -- which it refuses by design. All tolerances are therefore stated in the panel's OWN pixel units and converted to a value-space precision (px per decade -> factor per px), which is the honest statement. No tolerance was widened.
